title: How to Succeed in Affiliate Marketing Without an Audience (2026)
summary: Want to succeed as an affiliate marketer in 2026? Guess what? You don’t need an audience. You don’t need to "go viral" or to be an AI wizard. Before I dive in, let me give you a quick background: Last year, we paid out well over $100k to our affiliates at VideoGen, an AI video editing platform, with many top affiliates making thousands per month in recurring income. We've also worked with many affiliate marketers for other products who use our AI video editor to create promo videos. AI has made it super easy for anyone to create content.
